age_basis: retrieved_at relative to the scorecard generated_at date (UTC calendar days)

salary_threshold.basis: Salary thresholds such as the German EU Blue Card minimums are revised annually.

fee.basis: Visa and administrative fees are typically revised at most annually.

occupation_list.basis: Shortage and occupation lists can be updated several times a year.

deadline.basis: Application and funding deadlines change per intake cycle.

quota.basis: Quotas and caps are allocated per program period and can be exhausted mid-period.

processing_time.basis: Published processing times are refreshed monthly or quarterly.

financial_requirement.basis: Livelihood and blocked-account amounts are revised annually.

statutory_condition.basis: Non-numeric statutory conditions change through legislation rather than periodic revision.
